  3 weeks on, 1 week off roster.  
 
  FIFO from any major capital to Adelaide 
     
     
  $83+ per hour (inclusive of 25% casual loading and 30% shift loading) + overtime  
  Adelaide Site - Work Monday to Friday and enjoy your weekends off  
  Fly from any capital in Australia  
  Please note, onboarding and training will take place Week 1 on Day Shift. These hours will be paid at Day Shift Rate.

  Market leading pay rates of $83 per hour + overtime  
  3 Weeks On, 1 Week Off  
  Afternoon Shift & Night Shift Available  
  FIFO to a major capital city - Adelaide  
  Modern private accommodation - less than 10 minutes from the site!  
  $100 daily meal allowance

  Adhering to strong safety procedures and requirements

  Monday - Thursday 11:00pm - 7:30am  
  Friday 10:00pm - 6:00am

  Friday 11:00pm - 7:00am  
 
  Week 3  
 
  Monday - Thursday 11:00pm - 7:30am  
  Friday 10:00pm - 6:00am
